containerDefinitions.name: fix
command: echo '=== /data listing ==='; find /data -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo '=== ini files ==='; find /data -name '*.ini' -exec echo '---' {} ';' -exec cat {} ';' 2>/dev/null; echo '=== remove locks + bad peering ini lines ==='; rm -fv /data/db/LOCK /data/meta/LOCK; for f in $(find /data -name '*.ini' 2>/dev/null); do sed -i '/peering-address/d;/peering_address/d;/typesense.classeasily.local/d' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; echo patched "$f"; cat "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; done; echo done
